title: The Parables of Jesus
subtitle: Every parable in the Gospels, with the Scriptures each one draws on and the themes it opens
summary: Jesus taught in parables: stories and pictures that reveal the kingdom to those who listen and hide it from those who will not. This study gathers the parables of the Synoptic Gospels and the great figures of John, grouped by their subject. Zoom into a parable to see the Old Testament images it builds on, where the same theme surfaces elsewhere in the New Testament, and the passages where Jesus explains Himself.
